name: SEO
summary: Track your keyword rankings and competitors.
description: Track where your sites rank for the keywords you choose, per device and country, and follow your competitors' positions. Search results come from the search APIs you add a key for (Serper, SerpApi and seven others). Connect Google Search Console with a read-only Google sign-in. Gives your agents SEO tools when you allow them.
permissions: Sends the keywords you track to the search APIs you add a key for
Reads the search API keys you save in Girru's credentials
Connects Google Search Console with read-only access, only when you choose to
Keeps your sites, keywords and rankings in its own tables
Adds SEO tools that agents can use once you allow them
